item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Seoul Home Prices Rising Everywhere Except Gangnam…Will Rise Further Due to Heavy Capital Gains Tax" (장동혁 “강남 빼고 서울 집값 싹 올라…양도세 중과로 더 오를 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Seoul Home Prices Rising Everywhere Except Gangnam…Will Rise Further Due to Heavy Capital Gains Tax" (장동혁 “강남 빼고 서울 집값 싹 올라…양도세 중과로 더 오를 것”)

Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said on the 10th, "Home prices in Seoul have all risen again, except for Gangnam." With the four-year suspension of heavy capital gains tax on multiple homeowners in adjusted areas ending the previous day, the heavy taxation was reinstated from that day, prompting him to criticize the government's real estate policies. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 10일 “강남만 빼고 서울 집값이 싹 다 다시 올랐다”고 했다. 4년간 유예됐던 양도세 중과 유예 조치가 전날 종료되면서 이날부터 조정대상지역 내 다주택자에 대한 중과세가 다시 적용되는 가운데, 정부의 부동산 정책을 비판하고 나선 것이다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Representative Jang stated, "Is this Lee Jae-myung's 'surgical strike'? Gangnam, which he despises to death, has fallen, so is Lee Jae-myung smiling?" as he made these remarks. (장 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “이재명식 ‘서지컬 스트라이크’(정밀 타격)인가. 죽도록 미워하는 강남은 떨어졌으니 이재명은 웃고 있으려나”라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Representative Jang added, "Starting today, with the heavy capital gains tax on real estate resuming, it will rise even more," and "Everyone is pulling their listings off the market." He continued, "The rental market has already reached its limit," saying, "Jeonse (lump-sum deposit rent) has dried up, and monthly rent has increased by several hundred thousand won compared to last year." (장 대표는 “오늘부터 부동산 양도세 중과가 시작되면 더 오를 것”이라면서 “너도나도 매물을 거둬들이고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “전월세 시장은 이미 갈 데까지 갔다”면서 “전세는 씨가 말랐고, 월세는 작년보다 몇십만원씩 올랐다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang argued, "Once the election is over, they will raise the property tax and abolish the long-term holding special deduction for single-homeowners. Hell is truly waiting," and "Lee Jae-myung insists on 'real estate normalization' even to the death. To believe this is 'normal' is a 'abnormal' state of mind." (장 대표는 “선거만 끝나면 보유세 올리고, 장특공(1주택자 장기보유특별공제)도 폐지할 거다. 진짜 지옥이 기다리고 있다”면서 “이재명은 곧 죽어도 ‘부동산 정상화’라고 우긴다. 이게 ‘정상’이라고 믿는 정신 상태가 ‘비정상’”이라고 했다.)

He also targeted President Lee's owned home, saying, "Will the Bundang apartment just be advertised and never sold?" (또 이 대통령 소유 주택을 겨냥해 “분당 아파트는 광고만 하고 끝내 안 팔 건가”라고 했다.)

item.title: DP Launches ‘National Normalization Election Committee’… Chung Cheong-rae: “We Must Win the Election to Uproot the Insurrection Forces” (與 ‘국가정상화 선대위’ 출범…정청래 “선거 승리해야 내란 세력 뿌리 뽑아”)
item.description:
DP Launches ‘National Normalization Election Committee’… Chung Cheong-rae: “We Must Win the Election to Uproot the Insurrection Forces” (與 ‘국가정상화 선대위’ 출범…정청래 “선거 승리해야 내란 세력 뿌리 뽑아”)

The Democratic Party of Korea launched its election committee for the June 3 local elections on the 10th, shifting into full election mode. The party named the election committee the “Election Committee for the Normalization of the Republic of Korea” and held an inauguration ceremony. (더불어민주당은 10일 6·3 지방선거 선거대책위원회를 출범하고 본격 선거 체제로 돌입했다. 민주당은 선대위 이름을 ‘대한민국 국가 정상화 선거대책위원회’라고 이름짓고 출범식을 열었다.)

Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae stated, “The insurrection is not over yet, and the unrepentant insurrectionist forces are still stirring in various places. We must decisively judge those arrogant forces who, through ‘Yoon Again’ nominations, are once again dreaming of an insurrection in this election. We must win this election to cut off the seeds of insurrection and restore the collapsed democracy.” (정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 “아직도 내란은 끝나지 않았고 여전히 반성하지 않는 내련 세력이 곳곳에서 준동하고 있다”며 “이번 선거에서 ‘윤 어게인’ 공천으로 다시 내란을 꿈꾸는 저 오만한 세력들을 반드시 심판해야 한다. 이번 선거에서 반드시 승리해 내란의 싹을 잘라내고 무너진 민주주의를 바로 세워야 한다”라고 했다.)

Floor leader Park Chan-dae also said, “Look at the recent behavior of the People Power Party. Far from offering a genuine apology for the insurrection and far-right incitement, they have even attempted to nominate ‘Yoon Again’ candidates. We must eliminate the insurrection forces so they can never again stir on this land and secure stable national power for the sovereign government.” (한병도 원내대표도 “최근 국민의힘 행태를 보라. 내란과 극우 선동에 대한 진정한 사죄는 커녕 ‘윤 어게인’ 후보 공천까지 시도했다”며 “내란 세력이 다시는 이 땅에 준동할 수 없도록 청산하고 국민 주권 정부의 안정적 국정 동력을 확실하게 확보해야 한다”고 했다.)

According to the election committee personnel plan announced by Rep. Lee Yeon-hee, who serves as the Democratic Party’s strategic planning committee chair, Representative Chung will serve as the chair of the standing general election committee. (이날 민주당 전략기획위원장을 맡고 있는 이연희 의원이 발표한 선대위 인선안에 따르면 정 대표가 상임총괄선거대책위원회 위원장을 맡는다.)

The co-standing chairs of the election committee include floor leader Park Chan-dae, former North Chungcheong Province Governor Lee Si-jong, and former Constitutional Court Justice Kim Yi-su. Former Justice Kim had previously worked alongside Representative Chung and others as a legal representative for the impeachment team against former President Yoon Suk Yeol. (공동 상임선대위원장에는 한병도 원내대표와 이시종 전 충북지사, 김이수 전 헌법재판관 등이 이름을 올렸다. 김 전 재판관은 정 대표 등과 함께 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵소추단 법률대리인단으로 활동했었다.)

Additionally, the committee includes Ahn Sun-ha, a former policy researcher at the Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and a WHO advisor; Geum Hee-jeong, a Daegu resident and surgeon; and Lee Bona, a naturalized South Korean of Myanmar origin serving as an advisor to the Peaceful Unification Advisory Council. (이와 함께 WHO(세계보건기구) 자문관인 안선하 전 대외경제연구원 정책연구원, 대구 시민이자 외과의사인 금희정 씨, 민주평화통일자문회의 자문위원을 맡고 있는 미얀마 출신 귀화 한국인 이본아씨 등이 이름을 올렸다.)

The co-chairs of the election committee include seven supreme council members—Lee Eon-ju, Hwang Myeong-seon, Kang Deuk-gu, Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jeong-bok, Park Ji-won, and Park Gyu-hwan—along with 16 regional government head candidates. Actor Lee Won-jong was appointed as the grassroots election committee chair, General Secretary Cho Seung-rae as the general election campaign headquarters head, Policy Committee Chair Han Jeong-ae as the head of the Republic of Korea Normalization Headquarters, and Rep. Park Ju-min as the head of the ‘Odduk’ campaign rally team. (공동 선대위원장에는 이언주·황명선·강득구·이성윤·문정복·박지원·박규환 등 7명의 최고위원, 16명의 광역단체장 후보들이 이름을 올렸다.골목골목 선대위원장에는 배우 이원종 씨, 총괄 선대본부장에는 조승래 사무총장, 대한민국 국가정상화 본부장에는 한정애 정책위의장, 오뚝 유세단장에는 박주민 의원 등이 각각 임명됐다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Nearing End of Term, to Visit Netherlands and Kenya for 7-Day Trip (임기 끝나는 우원식 의장, 네덜란드·케냐 5박 7일 순방)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Nearing End of Term, to Visit Netherlands and Kenya for 7-Day Trip (임기 끝나는 우원식 의장, 네덜란드·케냐 5박 7일 순방)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik is set to visit the Netherlands and Kenya from the 10th for a seven-day trip. Speaker Woo's term as National Assembly Speaker will conclude on the 29th of this month. (우원식 국회의장은 10일부터 5박 7일간 네덜란드와 케냐를 방문한다. 우 의장은 이달 29일 국회의장 임기가 종료된다.)

According to the Office of the National Assembly Speaker, in the Netherlands, Speaker Woo will meet with House Speaker Tom van Campen and Senate Speaker Meijer Lee Bors to discuss ways to strengthen exchanges between the parliaments of the two countries. Given that the Netherlands is home to ASML, the world's largest semiconductor equipment company, the Speaker is expected to focus on cooperation in the semiconductor industry and enhancing supply chain competitiveness. (국회의장실에 따르면 우 의장은 네덜란드에서는 톰 반 캄픈 하원의장, 메이 리 보스 상원의장 등과 만나 양국 의회 간 교류 강화 방안 등을 논의한다. 네덜란드가 세계 최대 반도체 장비업체인 ASML을 보유한 만큼 반도체 산업에서의 협력과 공급망 경쟁력 제고에 주력할 방침이라고 밝혔다.)

In Kenya, Speaker Woo is scheduled to hold talks with President William Ruto, among others. The Speaker's Office stated, "Speaker Woo plans to discuss ways to expand trade and investment and enhance substantive cooperation, while also directly conveying the difficulties faced by Korean companies operating in the region." (케냐에서는 월리엄 루토 대통령 등과 회담을 할 예정이다. 의장실은 “우 의장은 교역·투자 확대 및 실질 협력 제고 방안을 논의하는 한편 현지에 진출한 국내 기업들의 애로사항도 직접 전달할 계획”이라고 했다.)

Joining the trip are Democratic Party lawmakers Jin Sun-mee, Baek Hye-ryun, and Yeom Tae-young, People Power Party lawmaker Kim Dae-sik, and Rebuilding Korea Party lawmaker Kim Jae-won. (이번 순방에는 더불어민주당 진선미·백혜련·염태영 의원, 국민의힘 김대식 의원, 조국혁신당 김재원 의원 등이 함께한다.)

On the 8th, Speaker Woo halted the submission of a constitutional amendment bill to the plenary session, which the Democratic Party had pushed forward without agreement with the People Power Party. Speaker Woo stated, "I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party, which brought in political tactics and unreasonable arguments to sabotage the constitutional amendment." However, the People Power Party countered, "A constitutional amendment without bipartisan agreement leads to dictatorship," and added, "The outcomes of excerpted amendments, rounding-up amendments, third-term amendments, and the Yushin Constitution—all pushed through despite opposition—have been marked by dictatorship and misfortune." (지난 8일 우 의장은 민주당이 국민의힘과 합의 없이 밀어붙였던 헌법 개정안 본회의 상정을 중단했다. 우 의장은 “정략과 억지 주장을 끌어들여 개헌을 무산시킨 국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표명하지 않을 수 없다”고 했다. 그러나 국민의힘은 “여야 합의 없는 개헌의 결말은 독재”라며 “(야당 반대에도 강행된) 발췌 개헌, 사사오입 개헌, 3선 개헌, 유신헌법까지 결말은 모두 독재와 불행으로 점철됐다”고 했다.)

item.title: Motherland Innovation Party Holds 'Pyeongtaek Parliamentary Meeting' in Full Force... "Pursuing Full Revision of the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support as Party Policy" (조국혁신당 ‘평택 의총’ 총출동...“평택지원특별법 개정 당론 추진”)
item.description:
Motherland Innovation Party Holds 'Pyeongtaek Parliamentary Meeting' in Full Force... "Pursuing Full Revision of the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support as Party Policy" (조국혁신당 ‘평택 의총’ 총출동...“평택지원특별법 개정 당론 추진”)

On the 10th, the Motherland Innovation Party held an on-site parliamentary meeting in the Pyeongtaek-eul district of Gyeonggi Province, where party leader Cho Kuk is running in a by-election, and decided to pursue a full revision of the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support as party policy. Additionally, all 12 party lawmakers will launch the 'One-Stone-Thirteen-Birds Lawmaker Volunteer Group,' taking charge of issues in eight towns, townships, and neighborhoods in Pyeongtaek-eul. This appears to be a move to focus all party resources on candidate Cho's campaign in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election. <<> On this day, the Motherland Innovation Party held an on-site parliamentary meeting at the Pyeongtaek Godeok STV Knowledge Industry Center. The meeting was attended by candidate Cho and 11 party lawmakers. <<> Candidate Cho stated, "Pyeongtaek is a city that simultaneously houses Samsung Electronics' campus, the world's largest single semiconductor plant, and the world's largest single overseas U.S. military base," adding, "I will propel this city, the strongest driver and beneficiary of the AI boom, into becoming 'the Global AI Nexus Pyeongtaek.'" <<> Regarding the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support, Candidate Cho said, "It is necessary to abolish sunset clauses and expand support for transportation and living infrastructure," and added that he will push for the legalization of national subsidy provisions. On this day, the Motherland Innovation Party decided to propose a revision of the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support as party policy. <<> Through the 'One-Stone-Thirteen-Birds Lawmaker Volunteer Group,' the Innovation Party plans to have lawmakers directly take charge of regional issues in Pyeongtaek-eul. Representative Cho stated, "I hope the residents of Pyeongtaek feel that 'by electing Cho Kuk, they get 12 lawmakers—one stone, thirteen birds.'" <<> The Innovation Party's lawmaker squad will also continue on-site schedules on this day, including visits to religious facilities and citizen meetings. (조국혁신당은 10일 조국 대표가 보궐선거에 출마한 경기 평택을 지역구에서 현장 의원총회를 열고 평택지원특별법 전면 개정을 당론으로 추진하기로 했다. 또 소속 국회의원 12명 전원이 평택을 8개 읍·면·동 현안을 나눠 맡는 ‘일석십삼조 의원자봉단’도 출범하기로 했다. 조 후보의 평택을 보궐선거에 모든 당력을 집중하는 모양새다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Blue House: "Investigation Team for M/V Namuho Completes On-Site Investigation... Under Review and Evaluation Among Relevant Agencies" ([속보] 靑 “나무호 조사단, 현장조사 마무리… 관계기관 간 검토·평가 중”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Blue House: "Investigation Team for M/V Namuho Completes On-Site Investigation... Under Review and Evaluation Among Relevant Agencies" ([속보] 靑 “나무호 조사단, 현장조사 마무리… 관계기관 간 검토·평가 중”)

The Blue House announced on the 10th that it has completed the on-site investigation into the fire on the South Korean ship 'M/V Namuho' in the Strait of Hormuz near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and is currently conducting a review and evaluation among relevant agencies. (청와대는 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 호르무즈 해협에서 발생한 한국 선박 ‘나무호’ 화재와 관련해 현장 조사를 마무리하고 관계 기관 간 검토·평가를 진행 중이라고 10일 밝혔다.)

The Blue House stated in an afternoon press notice, "The investigation team has finished the necessary on-site investigation, and after concluding local activities, they are expected to return individually depending on flight availability." It further explained, "We have received preliminary results from the on-site investigation and are currently reviewing and evaluating them among relevant agencies. The cause of the fire on M/V Namuho will be addressed following the review and evaluation of the on-site investigation results among relevant agencies." (청와대는 이날 오후 언론 공지를 통해 “조사단이 필요한 현장 조사를 마무리했고, 현지 활동 종료 후 항공 사정에 따라 개별 귀국할 예정”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “1차적인 현장 조사 결과를 받았으며 현재 관계 기관 간 검토 및 평가 중”이라며 “나무호 화재 원인은 현장 조사 결과에 대한 관계 기관 간 검토와 평가를 거쳐 답변드리겠다”고 설명했다.)

Earlier, the Blue House had maintained a cautious stance regarding claims by Iranian state media that the M/V Namuho incident resulted from military action, noting that analysis of the cause requires time as follow-up measures such as towing are still underway. (앞서 청와대는 이란 관영 매체가 나무호 사고를 무력 행사에 의한 것이라고 주장한 데 대해, 예인 등 후속 조치가 진행 중인 상황에서 원인 분석에는 시간이 필요하다며 신중한 입장을 유지해왔다.)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon Says "Busan Buk-gu Must Unite" - Urges Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon to Unify (박형준 “부산 북갑 통합해야” 박민식·한동훈 단일화 촉구)
item.description:
Park Hyung-joon Says "Busan Buk-gu Must Unite" - Urges Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon to Unify (박형준 “부산 북갑 통합해야” 박민식·한동훈 단일화 촉구 )

People Power Party's Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon stated on the 10th, "We must take the first step toward unity in the Busan Buk-gu National Assembly by-election." He urged the People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who are both running in the district, to unify. <<>> At a closed-door meeting of the Busan regional election campaign committee held that day, Park said, "To stop the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung regime and win the Busan election, we must end the division right now, starting from Busan Buk-gu." <<>> He added, "In a situation where we should focus on building a united front, all attention is being drawn to the division among conservatives," and "The Buk-gu by-election is swallowing up the entire Busan election, which has over 200 candidates." <<>> He continued, "We must break the vicious cycle of division, where the tail wags the dog," and "Only when Busan becomes the epicenter of unity can all 200 candidates achieve victory and protect South Korea's democracy." <<>> Park pointed out, "65% of conservative voters want unification," and "Indulging in a slugfest among conservative candidates under the complacent belief that a three-way race can still be won will ultimately divide conservative voters and turn away moderate voters as well." Although he did not directly name Park Min-sik or Han Dong-hoon, he urged them to pursue unification. <<>> Around 10 National Assembly members from the Busan region who attended the first election campaign committee meeting that day reportedly agreed that "now is the time to either unite together or lose together." Those present included People Power Party Busan City Party Chairman Rep. Jeong Dong-man, along with Reps. Kim Do-eup (4th term), Lee Heon-seung (4th term), Kim Hee-jung (3rd term), Kim Mi-ae (2nd term), Park Soo-young (2nd term), Baek Jong-heon (2nd term), Lee Seong-kwon (2nd term), Kwak Kyu-taek (1st term), Jeong Seong-guk (1st term), Jo Seung-hwan (1st term), and Joo Jin-woo (1st term). item.title: Jung Won-oh: "25 Million Won for Adopting Stray Dogs" Oh Se-hoon: "Pledge to Supply 7-Speed 'Ddareungi' Bikes" (정원오 “유기견 입양시 25만원 지급” 오세훈 “7단 따릉이 보급 약속”)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "25 Million Won for Adopting Stray Dogs" Oh Se-hoon: "Pledge to Supply 7-Speed 'Ddareungi' Bikes" (정원오 “유기견 입양시 25만원 지급” 오세훈 “7단 따릉이 보급 약속”)

On the 10th, Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party, competing for the position of Seoul Mayor in the June 3 local elections, each announced life-oriented pledges. (6·3지방선거에서 서울시장을 놓고 경쟁하는 더불어민주당 정원오·국민의힘 오세훈 후보가 10일 각각 생활밀착형 공약을 내놓았다.)

Candidate Jung Won-oh unveiled the "Seoul, the Happy Capital for Pet Families" pledge, which includes providing up to 250,000 won in adoption subsidies for families adopting stray or lost animals. The plan aims to significantly strengthen public care and welfare systems for pet-owning households, which account for one-fifth of Seoul's citizens. <<> Candidate Jung stated on Facebook that day, "We will establish a welfare system covering from adoption to care, treatment, and funerals, creating a city where pet owners and non-pet owners can coexist safely." He also visited a pet training and stray dog shelter at Gyeongdong Market in Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, to gather on-site opinions. <<> Candidate Jung had previously introduced a policy providing up to 250,000 won in adoption subsidies for families adopting stray, lost, or retired working dogs during his tenure as head of Seongdong-gu. If elected as Seoul Mayor, he plans to expand this policy citywide. He also announced the expansion and reorganization of the four existing Seoul Municipal Animal Welfare Support Centers into "Seoul Animal Welfare Hub Centers," with an additional hub to be established. Through this, an integrated administrative support system for reporting, rescuing, protecting, treating, adopting, and humanely managing stray and lost animals will be established. Adoption service standards, which currently differ by district, will also be standardized. Animal welfare, medical, and emergency response standards will be developed into a Seoul-type standard manual. <<> Public pet foster care centers will be established in all 25 districts of Seoul, and indoor and outdoor dog playgrounds will be expanded to every district. To address the biggest concern of pet-owning households—medical costs—Candidate Jung said he would collaborate with the central government to gradually introduce a "standard veterinary fee system." He also plans to develop a "Seoul-type Pet Care Safety System," allowing pet owners to be informed of essential and optional items during check-ups and prescriptions. Pet medical costs reached an average of 1.463 million won last year. Candidate Jung remarked, "Excessive medical costs lead to the abandonment of treatment and anxiety over pet ownership." <<> Candidate Oh Se-hoon announced a pledge to replace the current "3-gear Ddareungi" bikes with 7-gear bicycles that day. He also promised to upgrade the Climate Companion Card for use in some adjacent areas of Gyeonggi Province and to install a large gondola on Namsan. The name of this pledge is "Seoul's Great Transportation Transformation to Relieve Travel Discomfort." Candidate Oh's side said, "The focus is on reflecting citizens' practical needs, such as reducing commute times and easing transportation costs." <<> Candidate Oh plans to focus on the early completion of seven urban railway lines, including the Gangbuk Crossing Line, Myeonmok Line, Seobu Line, Mokdong Line, Nangol Line, Ui-Sinseol Extension Line, and Dongbuk Line. Starting next year, transportation infrastructure in the northeastern, northwestern, and southwestern districts will be completed sequentially, with the goal of finishing all projects by 2037. Additionally, internal transfer passages and elevators will be expanded at all subway stations to shorten transfer times to under 10 minutes. On high-altitude residential hills, region-specific monorails and elevators will be installed to alleviate inconvenience for elderly and mobility-impaired individuals who must navigate steep stairs. <<> Seoul's Climate Companion Card will be upgraded to the "Seoul Climate Companion Pass." With a monthly flat rate of 62,000 won, the plan is to expand the range of usage to include the GTX-A line to Dongtan and Paju in Gyeonggi Province and the Shinbundang Line to Seongnam City within Seoul's sections. The youth age limit will be extended to 42. The "K-Pass," which refunds users who use public transportation more than 15 times a month, will also support bus fares for citizens aged 70 and older who use the card. <<> The public bicycle "Ddareungi," currently equipped with a 3-speed gear, has been criticized for making uphill riding difficult. The plan is to replace it with a 7–8 speed gear model, allowing for easier climbing. A total of 45,000 Ddareungi bikes will be gradually replaced at a rate of 4,000 per year, in line with their replacement cycles. <<> A political source said that day, "The June 3 local elections are now 24 days away," adding, "The competition over candidates' pledges is expected to intensify." <<> (정원오 후보는 이날 유기·유실동물 입양 가정에 최대 25만원 규모의 입양지원금을 지원하는 ‘반려가족 행복수도 서울’ 공약을 발표했다. 서울시민의 5분의 1을 차지하는 반려동물 양육 가구를 위해 공공 돌봄·복지 체계를 대폭 강화하겠다는 구상이다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “We Need Park Min-sik, Not Someone Who Sowed Seeds of Conflict and Division” (장동혁 “갈등·분열 씨앗 뿌린 사람 아닌 박민식이 필요”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: “We Need Park Min-sik, Not Someone Who Sowed Seeds of Conflict and Division” (장동혁 “갈등·분열 씨앗 뿌린 사람 아닌 박민식이 필요” )

Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 10th regarding the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Buk-gu, Busan, that “Park Min-sik must be elected, not someone who sowed seeds of conflict and division.” This was interpreted as a remark targeting independent candidate Han Dong-hoon (former leader of the People Power Party), who is competing against Candidate Park in this district. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 10일 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거와 관련해서 “갈등·분열의 씨앗을 뿌린 사람이 아니라 박민식 후보가 당선되어야 한다”고 밝혔다. 이는 이 지역에서 박 후보와 경쟁하는 무소속 한동훈(전 국민의힘 대표) 후보를 겨냥한 발언으로 풀이됐다.)

At the opening ceremony of Candidate Park’s election office in Deokcheon-dong, Buk-gu, Busan, that day, Representative Jang said, “I am well aware that you have been disappointed in the People Power Party while we argued and divided among ourselves.” He added, “Shouldn’t we now reform the People Power Party?” and stated, “Someone like Park Min-sik (the candidate), who has steadfastly upheld conservatism, should create a new conservative party.” (장 대표는 이날 부산 북구 덕천동에서 열린 박 후보 선거사무소 개소식에서 “우리끼리 갈등하고 분열하면서 여러분이 그동안 국민의힘에 대해서 실망한 것을 잘 알고 있다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “이제 국민의힘을 새롭게 고쳐야 하지 않겠나”라며 “박민식(후보)처럼 굳건하게 보수를 지켜온 사람이 보수 정당을 새롭게 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang further remarked, “Candidate Park left Buk-gu for a time, but in that period, as the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, he went through multiple hardships and has returned as a deeper and greater public servant,” adding, “It’s not someone trying to use the People Power Party as a tool, but Park Min-sik, who can truly love the People Power Party, that we need.” (또 장 대표는 “박 후보가 잠시 북구를 떠났지만 그 사이에 국가보훈부 장관으로서 또 여러 차례 어려움을 겪으면서 더 깊고 더 큰 일꾼으로 다시 돌아왔다”며 “국민의힘이란 정당을 이용하려고 하는 사람이 아니라 국민의힘을 진정 사랑할 수 있는 박민식이 필요하다”고 했다.)

The by-election for the National Assembly seat in Buk-gu, Busan, held alongside the June 3 local elections, is a three-way race among Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea, Park Min-sik of the People Power Party, and independent Han Dong-hoon. Representative Jang also criticized Democratic Party candidate Ha, saying, “He is someone who lacks political knowledge and skills and should not engage in politics,” adding, “He is a candidate who worked with President Lee Jae-myung, who is ruining the entire Republic of Korea, and was sent down by President Lee’s appointment.” (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거는 더불어민주당 하정우 후보, 국민의힘 박민식 후보, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 3파전으로 맞붙는다. 장 대표는 민주당 하 후보에 대해서도 “정치도 모르고 할 줄도 모르는 정치를 해서는 안 될 사람”이라며 “대한민국을 통째로 망가뜨리고 있는 이재명 대통령과 같이 일하다가 이 대통령이 찍어서 내려보낸 그런 후보”라고 했다.)

At the opening ceremony that day, Candidate Park emphasized that he is a “true Buk-gu native.” He asked, “Would you believe it if people who suddenly appeared like pop-up shops claimed they would develop Buk-gu?” and said, “This is an insult to Buk-gu residents. In the Gyeongsang dialect, it’s treating them like fools.” He added, “This is a battle between a fake Buk-gu resident, an impersonator of Buk-gu residents, and the real Buk-gu native, Park Min-sik,” and pledged, “I will repay you with a sure victory for Park Min-sik.” (박 후보는 이날 개소식에서 ‘진짜 북구 사람’이라는 점을 강조했다. 그는 “떳다방처럼 난데없이 날아온 사람들이 북구를 발전시키겠다고 하면 여러분 믿으시겠냐”며 “이것은 북구 주민을 무시하는 것이다. 경상도 말로 ‘알로 보는 것’”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “가짜 북구 주민, 북구 주민 호소인과 진짜 북구 사람인 박민식의 싸움”이라며 “박민식 필승으로 보답하겠다”고 했다.)

He also stated, “Conservatives who engage in internal infighting, self-righteous conservatives, and such outdated conservatism should step aside now, and someone solid like me, Park Min-sik, will defend the Nakdong River defense line,” and said, “I will devote my life to saving Buk-gu and reviving our People Power Party.” (또 그는 “내부 총질하는 보수, 유아독존적인 보수, 그런 구태 보수는 이제 물러가고 저 박민식 같은 확실한 사람이 낙동강 방어선을 지킬 것”이라며 “북구를 살리고 우리 국민의힘을 살리기 위해서 제 한목숨 바치겠다”고 했다.)

At Candidate Park’s opening ceremony that day, the party leadership was out in full force, including Representative Jang, floor leader Song Eon-seok, supreme council members Kim Min-soo and Kim Jae-won, and Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong. Senior People Power Party lawmakers such as Kwon Young-se, Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, Cho Bae-sook, and Ahn Cheol-soo also gathered. Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate for Busan mayor, also attended the ceremony. Meanwhile, at a location about a 10-minute walk away, the opening ceremony for independent candidate Han Dong-hoon’s election office was also held. (이날 박 후보 개소식에는 장 대표, 송언석 원내대표, 김민수·김재원 최고위원, 정희용 사무총장 등 지도부가 총출동했다. 권영세·김기현·나경원·조배숙·안철수 의원 등 국민의힘 중진 의원들도 집결했다. 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보도 이날 개소식에 참석했다. 한편 같은 시간 도보로 10분가량 떨어진 거리에서는 한동훈 무소속 후보의 선거사무소 개소식도 열렸다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "Rebuilding conservatism, controlling Lee's prosecution withdrawal rampage" (한동훈 “보수 재건, 李 공소 취소 폭주 제어하겠다”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "Rebuilding conservatism, controlling Lee's prosecution withdrawal rampage" (한동훈 “보수 재건, 李 공소 취소 폭주 제어하겠다”)

Han Dong-hoon, independent candidate for the by-election for the Busan North-gu Gap National Assembly seat, held his campaign office opening ceremony on the 10th and stated, "I will change North-gu, which has always been a lower priority, into the true 'Gap.' I will rebuild conservatism. I will also control the rampage, like the cancellation of indictments under the Lee Jae-myung administration." He added, "If President Lee Jae-myung withdraws the indictment, we will impeach and remove him. We are the ones who prevented martial law." (한동훈 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거 무소속 후보는 10일 선거 사무소 개소식을 열고 “늘 후순위였던 북구를 진짜 ‘갑’으로 바꾸겠다. 보수를 재건하겠다”며 “또 이재명 정권의 공소 취소같은 폭주를 제어하겠다”고 했다. 이어 “이재명 대통령이 공소 취소하면 탄핵해서 끌어내리겠다, 우리는 계엄을 막은 사람들”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Han held the campaign office opening ceremony that afternoon at a building in Deokcheon Intersection, Busan North-gu. Introducing Grandma Kim, who handed him a filled rice lunchbox a few days ago during his campaign, Han said, "I had intended to gather powerful people and boast about them to the media, just as I had done until recently. But I met this person and changed my mind. I'd like to introduce the mother who runs a vegetable stall nearby and made me a filled rice lunchbox." (한 후보는 이날 오후 부산 북구 덕천교차로에 있는 한 빌딩에서 선거사무소 개소식을 열었다. 한 후보는 며칠 전 선거운동 중 자신에게 찰밥 도시락을 건넨 김모 할모니를 소개하면서 “힘 센 사람들을 모아놓고 언론에 자랑하는 것, 얼마 전까지만 해도 그렇게 하려 했다”면서 “그런데 제가 이 분을 만나 뵙고 생각을 바꿨다. 이 근처에서 채소 장사를 하면서 제게 찰밥도시락을 만들어주셨던 어머님을 소개한다”고 했다.)

Grandma Kim, who met Candidate Han a few days ago, gave him the filled rice lunchbox along with side dishes. Han was seen eating the lunchbox on the street, which became a hot topic. A few days prior to that, at their first meeting, Grandma Kim gave Han a tomato and has since prepared a lunchbox for him every day, it is reported. (며칠 전 한 후보를 만난 김 할머니는 찰밥 도시락과 반찬을 건넸다. 한 후보가 길바닥에서 도시락을 먹는 모습이 포착되며 화제가 됐었다. 이보다 며칠 전, 첫 만남에서 한 후보에게 토마토를 건넨 김 할머니는 이후 매일 도시락을 준비해왔다고 한다.)

He said, "After meeting Grandma Kim, I completely changed this opening ceremony into a festival for the residents. I will make a promise to fundamentally change North-gu for people like this mother." Han also said, "If I go to the Blue House after becoming a representative for North Gap, I will take the mother who packed me lunchboxes first." (그는 “(김 할머니를 만난 뒤) 이렇게 우리 개소식을 전적으로 주민과의 축제로 바꾸게 됐다”며 “어머님 같은 분을 위해 북구를 획기적으로 바꾸겠다는 약속을 드리겠다”고 했다. 한 후보는 “제가 북갑에서 (국회의원이 된 후에) 청와대로 가게 되면 (제게 도시락을 싸주신) 어머님을 제일 먼저 모시고 가겠다”고도 했다.)

After the approximately one-hour-long introduction of attendees, Honorary Election Committee Chairman Seo Byung-soo explained, "I was very worried because Candidate Han comes from an elite background, but he personally showed me that I was wrong. He is more traditionally conservative than People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik, and he is a candidate who works with the People Power Party." <<>> (약 1시간 동안 이어진 참석자 소개 후 서병수 명예선대위원장은 “한 후보는 엘리트 출신이어서 제가 걱정을 많이 했는데 제 생각이 틀렸다는 걸 몸소 보여주셨다”며 “박민식 국민의힘 후보보다도 가장 정통 보수에, 국민의힘과 같이 하는 후보”라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Pyeongtaek Struggles with Candidate Unification, Ulsan’s Democratic Party Says “In Talks at Central Party Level” (평택은 단일화 난항, 울산은 민주당 “중앙당 차원에서 대화 중”)
item.description:
Pyeongtaek Struggles with Candidate Unification, Ulsan’s Democratic Party Says “In Talks at Central Party Level” (평택은 단일화 난항, 울산은 민주당 “중앙당 차원에서 대화 중”)

<<>> With about 20 days left until the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections, major battlegrounds are facing difficulties in candidate unification. In the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-b National Assembly by-election and the Ulsan mayoral election, multiple candidates from both ruling and opposition parties, including independents, have created five- or six-way races. In Pyeongtaek-b, candidates are engaging in a daily war of nerves, claiming there will be “no political engineering alliances,” while in Ulsan, both ruling and opposition parties are leaving the door open for unification and holding negotiations. ()

In the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-b by-election, three candidates—Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party, Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, and Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party—are locked in a tight race within the margin of error, each with around 20% support in recent polls. According to a telephone survey of 502 voters in the Pyeongtaek-b district conducted by pollster Metavoice on behalf of JTBC on the 4th and 5th, support for Cho Kuk was 26%, Kim Yong-nam 23%, and Yoo Eui-dong 18%. All three are competing within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Additionally, Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party garnered 11%, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party received 6%. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재·보궐 선거를 20여 일 앞두고 주요 격전지에서 후보 단일화를 두고 난항을 겪고 있다. 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거와 울산시장 선거는 여야와 무소속 후보까지 출마하면서 5자, 6자 구도로 치러지고 있다. 평택을에선 후보들이 “정치 공학적인 결합은 없다”며 연일 신경전을 이어가는 가운데, 울산에선 여야 모두 단일화 가능성을 열어두고 협상을 진행 중이다.)

Within the broader opposition bloc, the Progressive Party is demanding unification, while the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party are exchanging sharp remarks daily over whether to unite. In a media interview on the 10th, Kim said, “If parties are different, it’s right to field separate candidates and finish the race.” On the same day, in a phone call with this newspaper, Cho stated, “The combined support for Yoo Eui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn is shrinking, and ultimately it will become a race between Cho Kuk and Kim Yong-nam,” adding, “I will win by three votes.” However, a Democratic Party official said, “Since we don’t know what will happen if the conservative camp unifies, we are closely monitoring poll trends.” (경기 평택을 재선거는 더불어민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국 등 3명 후보가 최근 여론조사에서 오차 범위 안 20%대에서 혼전을 벌이고 있다. JTBC 의뢰로 여론조사기관 메타보이스가 지난 4~5일 평택을 지역 유권자 502명에게 전화 면접 방식으로 물은 결과 조국 후보를 지지한다는 응답은 26%였다. 김용남 후보가 23%, 유의동 후보는 18%였다. 세 후보 모두 오차 범위(±4.4%포인트) 내에서 다투는 상황이다. 이 밖에 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 11%, 진보당 김재연 후보 6%였다.)

The biggest variable in the Ulsan mayoral election is also candidate unification. In a poll conducted by Polling Fair on the 4th and 5th on behalf of KBS Ulsan Broadcasting and Ulsan Maeil Newspaper, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook received 32.9%, People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-gyeom 37.1%, within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). Following them were Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party at 14.2%, and independent candidate Park Maeng-woo, who left the People Power Party, at 8.5%. (범여권에선 진보당이 단일화를 요구하는 가운데, 민주당과 조국혁신당은 단일화 여부를 두고 연일 날 선 발언을 주고받고 있다. 김 후보는 10일 언론 인터뷰에서 “정당이 다르면 각자 후보를 내고 끝까지 완주하는 것이 옳다”고 했다. 조 대표도 이날 본지 통화에서 “갈수록 유의동·황교안 후보 지지율의 합은 줄어들어 결국은 조국이냐 김용남이냐가 될 것”이라며 “내가 3표 차이로 이길 것”이라고 했다. 다만 민주당 관계자는 “보수 진영 단일화가 이뤄지면 어떻게 될지 모르는 만큼 여론조사 추이를 면밀히 지켜보고 있다”고 했다.)

On the 10th, Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing, “We recently unified with Gal Sang-don, the Democratic Party candidate in the Jinju mayoral election (with the Progressive Party), becoming a single candidate. The ‘Jinju model’ will continue to be created,” hinting at the possibility of central party-level unification efforts. Previously, the Democratic Party had stated, “There will be no central party involvement in unification.” The recent shift by independent candidate Park Maeng-woo, who declared his run after being excluded from nomination, toward unification and entering discussions with Kim Doo-gyeom appears to have influenced the situation. (울산시장 선거의 최대 변수도 후보 단일화다. KBS울산방송·울산매일신문 의뢰로 여론조사공정이 지난 4~5일 실시한 여론조사에서 민주당 김상욱 후보 32.9%, 국민의힘 김두겸 후보 37.1%로 오차 범위(±3.5%포인트) 내였다. 뒤이어 김종훈 진보당 후보가 14.2%, 국민의힘에서 탈당한 박맹우 무소속 후보가 8.5%였다.)

item.title: From His First Term as a Lawmaker to After His Presidency...Choi Young, ‘Roh Moo-hyun’s Driver for 21 Years,’ Passes Away (초선부터 대통령 이후까지...‘노무현 21년 운전사’ 최영씨 별세)
item.description:
From His First Term as a Lawmaker to After His Presidency...Choi Young, ‘Roh Moo-hyun’s Driver for 21 Years,’ Passes Away (초선부터 대통령 이후까지...‘노무현 21년 운전사’ 최영씨 별세)

The late former President Roh Moo-hyun had a long-serving driver by his side. It was Choi Young, an executive secretary who accompanied him for 21 years, from the early days of his political career to the Blue House and Bongha Village. He passed away on the 10th. He was 62. (고(故) 노무현 전 대통령의 곁에는 오랫동안 같은 운전기사가 있었다. 정치 입문 초기부터 청와대, 봉하마을까지 21년을 함께한 수행비서 최영(崔永) 씨다. 그가 10일 별세했다. 향년 62세.)

According to his family, the deceased passed away that morning at the National Medical Center in Seoul. He had been receiving treatment after being diagnosed with lung cancer last year. (유족에 따르면 고인은 이날 오전 서울 국립중앙의료원에서 세상을 떠났다. 지난해 폐암 진단을 받고 치료를 받아왔다.)

Born in Geumsan, South Chungcheong Province, the deceased began his relationship with Roh Moo-hyun in 1988 when he took on the role of driver for Roh, then a first-term lawmaker in the 13th National Assembly. He was introduced by Lee Kwang-jae, who was then an aide. Thereafter, he remained by Roh’s side through his tenure as a lawmaker, Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries, President-elect, and during his years at the Blue House, continuing until after his retirement to Bongha Village in 2009. (충남 금산 출신인 고인은 1988년 노무현 당시 13대 국회 초선 국회의원의 차량 운전을 맡으면서 인연을 맺었다. 이광재 당시 보좌관의 소개였다. 이후 국회의원, 해양수산부 장관, 대통령 당선인 시절과 청와대 재임 기간을 거쳐 2009년 퇴임 후 봉하마을까지 곁을 지켰다.)

Those around him remember the deceased as a man of few words and cautious nature. It is said that he rarely spoke about work even with his family. His older brother, Choi Young-gun, said, “Whenever President Roh got into the car, he would turn the rearview mirror away and drive using only the side mirrors, just so he could be a little more comfortable.” (주변에서는 고인을 말수가 적고 신중한 사람으로 기억한다. 가족들에게도 업무 이야기를 거의 하지 않았다고 한다. 형 최영군 씨는 “노 대통령이 차에 타면 조금이라도 편하게 계시도록 룸미러를 돌려놓고 사이드미러만 보며 운전했다”고 말했다.)

It is said that former President Roh also trusted him deeply. Even during the process of replacing security vehicle drivers after his election as president, he tried to keep his existing driver, and Mr. Choi took the wheel of the armored vehicle after receiving security driving training from the Blue House Security Service. (노 전 대통령도 고인을 신뢰했다고 한다. 대통령 당선 이후 경호 차량 운전사를 교체하는 과정에서도 기존 수행을 유지하려 했고, 최 씨는 청와대 경호실의 경호운전 교육을 받은 뒤 방탄 차량 운전대를 잡았다.)

The deceased recalled three moments that particularly stood out in his memory: the day he personally drove the bus carrying former President Roh when he appeared before the prosecution, the schedule for the visit to Pyongyang, and the moment he drove the hearse at the time of his passing in 2009. (고인은 생전 세 장면을 특히 기억에 남겼다고 한다. 검찰 출두 당시 노 전 대통령이 탄 버스를 직접 운전했던 날, 평양 방문 일정, 그리고 2009년 서거 당시 영구차를 운전했던 순간이다.)

Even after former President Roh’s death, he remained in Bongha Village to accompany Kwon Yang-sook, the former first lady. His wife, Kim Jeong-hwa, recalled, “Before leaving the Blue House and heading down to Bongha Village, President Roh asked, ‘You’re coming along, right?’ and I heard my husband replied without hesitation, ‘Is there any question about that?’” (노 전 대통령 별세 이후에도 그는 봉하마을에 남아 권양숙 여사를 수행했다. 부인 김정화 씨는 “청와대를 떠나 봉하마을로 내려가기 전 노 대통령이 ‘함께 갈 거지’라고 물었는데, 남편이 바로 ‘여부가 있겠습니까’라고 답했다고 들었다”고 전했다.)

The 23rd of this month marks the 17th anniversary of former President Roh’s passing. The person who held the steering wheel closest to him for so long has also departed to be by his side. (오는 23일은 노 전 대통령 추모 17주기다. 오랜 시간 가장 가까운 자리에서 운전대를 잡았던 사람도 그의 곁으로 떠났다.)

The deceased is survived by his wife, Ms. Kim, a son and a daughter (Choi Jae-sik and Choi Joo-yeon), his older brother Choi Young-gun, and his younger sister Choi Kyung-mi, among others. The funeral hall is set up in Room 305 at the National Medical Center, and the funeral procession will depart at 8:00 a.m. on the 12th. Contact: (02)2262-4822. <<>> (유족은 부인 김씨와 1남1녀(최재식·최주연), 형 최영군씨, 동생 최경미씨 등이 있다. 빈소는 국립중앙의료원 305호실, 발인 12일 오전 8시. (02)2262-4822)

item.title: Busan's Buk-gu: "I Am the True Native Here," Says Park Min-sik at Campaign Launch as Party Leadership Rallies (“진짜 북구 사람은 나” 박민식 후보 개소식, 지도부 총출동)
item.description:
Busan's Buk-gu: "I Am the True Native Here," Says Park Min-sik at Campaign Launch as Party Leadership Rallies (“진짜 북구 사람은 나” 박민식 후보 개소식, 지도부 총출동)

The leadership and lawmakers of the People Power Party (PPP) turned out in full force for the campaign office opening of Park Min-sik, the party's candidate for the June 3 by-election for the Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat in Busan. (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마하는 박민식 국민의힘 후보의 개소식에 국민의힘 지도부와 의원들이 총출동했다.)

At Park's campaign office opening held in Busan's Buk-gu on the afternoon of the 10th, the PPP leadership, including Acting Chairperson Jang Dong-hyuk, gathered in large numbers to showcase their strength. Attendees included Floor Leader Song Eon-seok, Supreme Council members Kim Min-soo, Kim Jae-won, and Cho Kwang-han, as well as Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong. Also present were five-term lawmakers Kwon Young-se, Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, and Cho Bae-sook, four-term lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, and other senior lawmakers including Kang Sun-young, Kim Min-jeon, Kim Jang-kyum, Park Joon-tae, and Park Choong-kwon. Among the 17 PPP lawmakers from the Busan region, nine attended, including Kwak Kyu-taek, Park Seong-hoon, Park Soo-young, Baek Jong-heon, Seo Ji-young, Lee Heon-seung, Jeong Dong-man, Cho Seung-hwan, and Joo Jin-woo. Busan Mayor Park Hyung-joon and former Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Won Hee-ryong were also in attendance. <<> At the event, Park emphasized that he is a "true native of Buk-gu." He asked, "If people flew in like a pop-up store and said they would develop Buk-gu, would you believe them?" adding, "That is insulting the residents of Buk-gu. In the Gyeongsang-do dialect, that's treating them like they're not worth anything." Park's 91-year-old mother, who raised him and his five siblings alone in Gupo, also joined the ceremony. <<> Acting Chairperson Jang described Park as "a true worker born and raised in Buk-gu, a true Buk-gu native." Referring to Democratic Party of Korea candidate Ha Jung-woo, Jang said, "He doesn't know how to do politics and is unfit for it. He's a candidate sent down by Lee Jae-myung, who is ruining the entire country." <<> Floor Leader Song remarked about one candidate, "I won't talk about the person who wears white clothes," and then targeting Ha, criticized, "He's someone not ready to enter politics. Does it make sense for someone who worked hard in the market to raise fine children, only to shake his hand off after shaking hands with a merchant?" <<> Lawmaker Na Kyung-won also stated, "When I went to Gupo Market, it was filled with outsiders coming and going. Don't we need someone who can develop Buk-gu?" Lawmaker Kwon Young-se also chanted slogans like "Out with the drifters" and "Even if you dislike it, give it one more chance." <<> Park declared, "This is a fight between fake Buk-gu residents and complainants, and Park Min-sik, the true Buk-gu native. I will repay you with Park Min-sik's inevitable victory." He added, "Conservatives who fight among themselves, self-righteous conservatives—those outdated conservatives should step aside. Someone reliable like me, Park Min-sik, will defend the Nakdong River line. I will devote my life to reviving Buk-gu and saving our People Power Party." (10일 오후 부산 북구에서 열린 박 후보 개소식에는 장동혁 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부가 대거 집결해 세를 과시했다. 장 대표와 송언석 원내대표, 김민수·김재원·조광한 최고위원, 정희용 사무총장 등이 참석했다. 이 밖에 5선의 권영세·김기현·나경원·조배숙 의원과 4선의 안철수 의원 등 중진 의원과 강선영·김민전·김장겸·박준태·박충권 의원도 한자리에 모였다. 국민의힘 소속 부산 지역 국회 의원 17명 중 곽규택·박성훈·박수영·백종헌·서지영·이헌승·정동만·조승환·주진우 의원 등 9명이 참석했다. 박형준 부산시장과 원희룡 전 국토교통부 장관도 참석했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo: "I'm Here to Work... Will Devote AI Expertise for Buk-gu" (하정우 “난 일하러 온 사람...북구 위해 AI 전문성 쏟겠다”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo: "I'm Here to Work... Will Devote AI Expertise for Buk-gu" (하정우 “난 일하러 온 사람...북구 위해 AI 전문성 쏟겠다”)

Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, held the opening ceremony of his election campaign office on the 10th. Ha, a former senior presidential secretary for AI future strategy at the Blue House, emphasized his image as a "working candidate" at the opening ceremony, stating, "As a son of Buk-gu, I will pour all my AI expertise into shaping Buk-gu's future." (더불어민주당 하정우 부산 북갑 보궐선거 후보가 10일 선거 사무소 개소식을 열었다. 청와대 AI미래기획수석 출신인 하 후보는 이날 개소식에서 “북구의 아들 하정우가 북구의 미래를 위해 AI(인공지능) 전문성을 모두 쏟아붓겠다”며 ‘일하는 후보’ 이미지를 강조했다.)

Candidate Ha said, "In the AI era, cities that set direction first and act quickly will take the lead," adding, "I believe Buk-gu can become just such a city." He then mentioned Jeon Jae-su, the Democratic Party candidate for Busan mayor and a three-term lawmaker from Buk-gu, saying, "Ha Jung-woo will properly finish what my respected hyung (older brother) Jeon started, and add future industries and AI capabilities to it." (하 후보는 “AI 시대에는 먼저 방향을 잡고 빠르게 실행하는 도시가 앞서가게 된다”면서 “북구가 바로 그런 도시가 될 수 있다고 믿는다”고 했다. 이어 북구에서 3선을 한 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보를 언급하며 “하정우가 재수 행님(형님)이 시작한 일을 단디 마무리하고 거기에 미래 산업과 AI 실력을 더하겠다”고 했다.)

Ha also stated, "With the golden combo of Jeon Jae-su and Ha Jung-woo, and the power of the invincible fleet for Buk-gu's development—leading from Lee Jae-myung to Jeon Jae-su to Ha Jung-woo—I will definitely accelerate the era of Buk-gu," adding, "I will join hands with the Busan mayor for Buk-gu's development. I will also meet with ministers and the Blue House chief of staff, and even negotiate directly with the president." (하 후보는 또 “전재수와 하정우의 황금 콤비, 이재명-전재수-하정우로 이어지는 북구 발전의 무적함대의 힘으로 북구의 시간을 반드시 앞당기겠다”면서 “북구 발전을 위해 부산시장과 손 잡겠다. 장관들, 청와대 비서실장도 만나겠다. 대통령과도 담판 짓겠다”라고 했다.)

Targeting People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, Ha said, "I did not come into politics to fight or bicker. I am not someone trying to make a name for myself by using Buk-gu, nor am I using Buk-gu as a stepping stone," adding, "I came here to work. I will deliver results instead of political strife." (하 후보는 국민의힘 박민식 후보, 무소속 한동훈 후보를 겨냥해 “저는 쌈박질하러 정치하러 온 사람이 아니다. 북구를 이용해서 자기 이름 알리고, 북구를 본인 발판 삼아 온 사람도 아니다”라면서 “저는 일하러 온 사람이다. 정쟁 대신 성과를 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Seemingly aware of recent controversies over a "handshake and wipe" gesture and the use of "oppa" as a title, Ha said, "When it comes to politics, I am a complete 'total beginner.' I have made mistakes and have offered apologies," but added, "What I can say for certain is that I am learning at a terrifyingly fast pace." (하 후보는 최근 제기됐던 ‘악수 후 손 털기’, ‘오빠 호칭’ 논란을 의식한 듯 “저는 정치로 보자면 완전 ‘생초수퍼 초보’다. 실수도 있었고 사과 말씀도 드렸다”면서 “하지만 분명히 말씀드릴 수 있는 것은 저는 지금 엄청 무서운 속도로 배우고 있다는 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Jeon Jae-su, who attended the opening ceremony, also said, "When Jeon Jae-su's 'dream of a maritime capital' combines with Ha Jung-woo's 'dream of making Korea one of the top three AI powers,' Busan will undergo earth-shattering changes." The ceremony also featured a performance where Jeon handed over a baton inscribed with "Buk-gu's Future" to Ha. (개소식에 참석한 전재수 후보도 “전재수의 ‘해양수도의 꿈’과 하정우의 ‘AI 3대 강국의 꿈’이 합쳐지면 부산에는 천지개벽할 변화가 생길 것”이라고 했다. 개소식에선 전 후보가 하 후보에게 ‘북구의 미래’가 적힌 바통을 넘겨주는 퍼포먼스도 했다.)

Meanwhile, the opening ceremony was attended by former Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Kim Young-choon—who serves as Ha's honorary campaign co-chair—lawmaker Kim Young-jin, and candidate Jeon. Party leadership, including Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, were absent as they attended the launch ceremony of the election strategy committee for Min Hyeong-bae, candidate for the special integrated city of Gwangju and South Jeolla Province, held at the same time in Gwangju. (한편 이날 개소식에는 하 후보의 명예선대위원장을 맡고 있는 김영춘 전 해양수산부 장관·김영진 의원, 전 후보 등이 참석했다. 정청래 대표를 포함한 당 지도부는 같은 시간 광주광역시에서 열린 민형배 전남광주통합특별시장 후보 선거대책위원회 출범식에 참석하느라 불참했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's Cho Seung-rae Calls Kim Kwan-young, Who Is Running as an Independent for North Jeolla Governor, "Permanently Barred from Rejoining" (민주당 조승래, ‘무소속 전북지사 출마’ 김관영에 “영구 복당 불허 대상”)
item.description:
Democratic Party's Cho Seung-rae Calls Kim Kwan-young, Who Is Running as an Independent for North Jeolla Governor, "Permanently Barred from Rejoining" (민주당 조승래, ‘무소속 전북지사 출마’ 김관영에 “영구 복당 불허 대상” )

Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 10th regarding North Jeolla Governor Kim Kwan-young, who declared his independent candidacy and expressed intent to rejoin the party after being elected, "Who does he think he is to rejoin as he pleases?" adding, "The Democratic Party is not a party that one can enter and leave at their own will." (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 10일 무소속 출마를 선언한 김관영 전북지사가 ‘당선 후 복당하겠다’는 뜻을 밝힌 데 대해 “누구 마음대로 복당하나”라며 “민주당이라는 공당은 본인 마음대로 들락날락할 수 있는 정당이 아니다”라고 했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly that day, Secretary-General Cho said, "Governor Kim is a person permanently barred from rejoining the party." Kim was expelled from the party last month after suspicions arose over the payment of proxy fees at a meal gathering. However, after Rep. Lee Won-taek, who faced allegations of paying for meals, was confirmed as the party's candidate for North Jeolla Governor, Kim raised issues of fairness and recently declared his independent candidacy. (조 사무총장은 이날 국회에서 열린 기자간담회에서 “김 지사는 영구 복당 불허 대상자”라며 이같이 말했다. 김 지사는 지난달 식사 자리에서 대리비 지급 의혹이 불거진 직후 당에서 제명됐다. 그러나 식사비 대납 의혹이 불거진 이원택 의원이 당내 전북지사 후보로 확정되자 형평성 문제를 제기하며 무소속 출마를 최근 선언했다.)

Secretary-General Cho stated, "Governor Kim's independent run is not only a rejection of the party's nomination but also a serious act of party disloyalty. I make it clear that, according to the party constitution and rules, he will never be allowed to rejoin." He further added, "If there are party members assisting Governor Kim, that also constitutes a clear act of disloyalty, and the special committee will take strict measures." (조 사무총장은 “(김 지사의 무소속 출마는) 공천 불복일 뿐 아니라 중대한 해당 행위이기에 당헌·당규에 따라 영원히 복당이 불가능하다는 점을 분명히 말씀드린다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “김 지사를 돕는 당원들이 있다면 이 또한 명백한 해당 행위에 해당하기에 특위에서 엄중 조치하겠다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Cho said, "It is shameless for him to portray the party leadership as having oppressed him or orchestrated this. Since his statements are based on clear falsehoods, we are even considering legal responses." (조 사무총장은 “당 지도부가 자기를 탄압한 것처럼, 또 그것을 기획한 것처럼 표현하는 것은 후안무치한 일”이라며 “명백한 허위사실에 기초한 발언인 만큼 법률적 대응까지 검토하겠다”고 말했다.)

Referring to the negotiations for a single opposition candidate in the Ulsan mayoral election with the Progressive Party, Secretary-General Cho said, "The central party is actively involved," and "We are continuing discussions with candidate Kim Sang-wook and the Ulsan city party chairman." He added, "In Jinju, our party's candidate Gal Sang-don became the sole candidate for mayor, and in the Gyeongnam provincial council elections, we achieved a unified candidacy with the Progressive Party candidate. This kind of 'Jinju model' will continue to be developed." (조 사무총장은 진보당과의 울산시장 단일화 협상을 언급하며 “중앙당이 적극적으로 움직이지 않는 것은 아니다”며 “김상욱 후보, 울산시당위원장과 계속 논의를 공유하고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “진주에서는 우리 당 갈상돈 후보가 진주시장 단일후보가 됐고, 경남도의원 선거에서도 진보당 후보와 단일화 결실을 맺은 사례가 있다”며 “이런 식의 ‘진주형 모델’이 계속 만들어질 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Iran's Ambassador to South Korea Silent on Findings of 'Aircraft Strike on Korean Ship' (주한이란대사, ‘비행체 韓선박 타격’ 조사결과에 묵묵부답)
item.description:
Iran's Ambassador to South Korea, Saeed Koozechi, remained silent on the 10th when asked by reporters about the government's investigation results indicating that a fire on a Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz was caused by a strike from an unidentified aircraft. (사이드 쿠제치 주한이란대사는 10일 호르무즈 해협의 한국 선박 화재가 미상 비행체의 타격에서 비롯됐다는 정부의 조사 결과에 대해 기자들의 질문에 침묵했다.)

Ambassador Koozechi was seen entering the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, coinciding with the government's briefing on the investigation results. While the ministry said it was to explain the findings, observers suggest it was effectively a summoning. There is speculation that the government, which had previously been cautious about claims of an external attack, called in the Iranian ambassador "to hold Iran accountable based on the investigation results." (쿠제치 대사는 이날 정부 조사 결과 브리핑에 맞춰 서울 종로구 외교부 청사를 들어서는 모습이 포착됐다. 외교부는 조사 결과를 설명하기 위한 것이라고 했지만 사실상 초치 성격이라는 관측이 나온다. 외부 공격 주장에 신중했던 우리 정부가 이란 대사를 부른 것을 두고 “조사 결과를 바탕으로 이란에 책임 추궁을 하려는 것 아니냐”는 것이다.)

Upon leaving the ministry building that day, Ambassador Koozechi encountered reporters asking for his stance on the investigation results and stated, "We only discussed some general issues related to this accident." When asked whether the Iranian government still maintains that the Iranian military was not involved in the ship fire, he simply replied, "Ask (Iran's) Foreign Ministry." (쿠제치 대사는 이날 외교부 청사를 나서면서 조사 결과에 대해 입장을 밝혀달라는 기자들을 만나 “우리는 단지 이 사고(accident)에 관한 일반적인 이슈 일부에 관해 이야기했다”고 했다. 그는 이란 군이 선박 화재에 관여하지 않았다는 게 이란 정부의 여전한 입장이냐는 질문에는 “(이란) 외교부에 물어보라”고만 했다)

Ambassador Koozechi arrived at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs shortly after the government's joint investigation team announced the cause of the ship fire. According to the ministry, First Vice Minister Park Yoon-joo explained the investigation results to Ambassador Koozechi. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il said, "We will not prejudge the entity responsible for the attack and will communicate with relevant countries, including Iran and the United States, regarding these findings." (쿠제치 대사는 이날 정부 합동 조사단의 선박 화재 원인 발표 직후 외교부에 도착했다. 외교부에 따르면 박윤주 1차관이 쿠제치 대사에게 조사 결과를 설명했다고 한다. 박일 외교부 대변인은 “공격의 주체를 예단하지 않을 것이며 이번 조사 결과와 관련해 이란과 미국을 비롯한 관련국과 소통하겠다”고 했다.)

When asked whether the United States was aware of the entity behind the attack or whether South Korea had received any relevant information from the US, Spokesperson Park responded, "Please understand that it is difficult to provide specific details." (박 대변인은 미국이 공격 주체를 알고 있었던 것인지, 미국으로부터 관련 정보를 받은 것은 없었는지에 대한 질문에는 “구체적으로 말하기가 제한됨을 양해해주기 바란다”고만 했다.)

Spokesperson Park added, "The government will thoroughly investigate the cause of this incident and, to prevent recurrence, pursue all available measures, including cooperation with the international community, to ensure the safety of our citizens." He also stated, "We are carefully reviewing the issue of participating in US-led initiatives, including the Maritime Free-Flow Initiative (MFC)." (박 대변인은 “금번 사고의 원인을 철저하게 규명을 하고 재발 방지를 위해서 국제사회와의 공조를 비롯하여 가능한 모든 방안을 추진함으로써 우리 국민 안전 확보에 정부는 만전을 기해 나가고자 한다”며 “미국의 해양자유구상(MFC)을 비롯한 미측 구상 참여 문제에 대해서도 면밀하게 검토 중”이라고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Blue House Holds NSC Working-Level Committee Meeting with Relevant Ministries Over NAMUHO Incident ([속보] 靑, 나무호 관련 관계부처 NSC 실무위원회 개최)
item.description:
<<>> The Blue House announced on the 10th that it had convened a working-level committee meeting of the National Security Council (NSC), attended by relevant ministries including the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, regarding the explosion incident involving the South Korean-flagged vessel 'NAMUHO' that occurred in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th. ()

The Blue House had previously refrained from convening an NSC meeting over the NAMUHO explosion, stating that it could not be conclusively determined as an attack. However, on this day, after a government investigation revealed that the fire "originated from strikes by two unidentified flying objects," it was reported that the NSC working-level committee was held to discuss response measures. (청와대는 지난 4일 호르무즈 해협에서 발생한 한국 국적 선박 ‘나무호’ 폭발 사고와 관련해 10일 “해양수산부 등 관계 부처가 참여한 NSC(국가안전보장회의) 실무위원회를 개최했다”고 밝혔다.)

Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il stated during a briefing that day, "The investigation confirmed that two unidentified flying objects struck the stern of HMM." Spokesperson Park added, "The engine room fire appears to have been ignited by the first strike from the unidentified flying objects, followed by a second strike that rapidly escalated the scale of the fire, and the cause of the fire is presumed unrelated to the ship's internal systems." However, the government did not specifically identify the attacking entity, such as Iran. (청와대는 그간 나무호 폭발 사고에 대해 “피격으로 단정할 수 없다”며 NSC를 열지 않아왔다. 그러나 이날 “화재가 미상 비행체 2기의 타격에서 비롯됐다”는 정부 조사 결과​가 나오자 NSC 실무위원회를 열고 대응 방안을 논의한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned the Iranian ambassador to South Korea to its headquarters on the same day to convey the investigation results and confirm the facts. (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 브리핑에서 “조사 결과 미상의 비행체 2기가 HMM 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인됐다”고 했다. 박 대변인은 “기관실 화재는 미상의 비행체 1차 타격으로 발화가 되고 이후 2차 타격으로 화재 규모가 급격히 확산된 것으로 보이며, 화재 원인은 선박 내부와는 무관한 것으로 추정된다”고 했다. 다만 정부는 공격 주체를 이란 등으로 특정하지는 않았다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Ministry of Foreign Affairs: "Fire on MV NAMUHO, Unknown Aerial Vehicle Struck the Stern" ([속보] 외교부 “나무호 화재, 미상 비행체가 선미 타격”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Ministry of Foreign Affairs: "Fire on MV NAMUHO, Unknown Aerial Vehicle Struck the Stern" ([속보] 외교부 “나무호 화재, 미상 비행체가 선미 타격”)

On the 10th, the South Korean government announced that the explosion incident involving the MV NAMUHO, a cargo ship operated by HMM (formerly Hyundai Merchant Marine), which occurred on the 4th in the Strait of Hormuz near the United Arab Emirates (UAE), was "caused by an external strike." Earlier that day, the presidential office had stated that a field investigation into the fire on the MV NAMUHO had been completed, and a review and evaluation among relevant agencies was underway. (지난 4일 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 호르무즈 해협에서 발생한 한국 HMM 소속 화물선 ‘나무호’ 폭발 사고에 대해 우리 정부가 “외부 피격에 따른 것”이라고 10일 밝혔다. 앞서 청와대는 이날 나무호 화재와 관련해 현장 조사를 마무리하고 관계 기관 간 검토·평가를 진행 중이라고 했었다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the same day, "The investigation confirmed that an unknown aerial vehicle struck the stern of the HMM vessel." It added that it is unclear whether the unknown aerial vehicle's attack involved drones like Iran's Shahed, which can adjust explosive power through warhead modifications. The ministry noted, "There are limitations in confirming the exact model and physical size," and added, "We plan to further analyze debris collected at the scene." (외교부는 이날 “조사 결과 미상의 비행체가 HMM 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인됐다”고 했다. 미상의 비행체가 탄두 교체를 통해 폭발력을 조절할 수 있는 이란의 샤헤드 등 드론의 공격에 의한 것인지는 불분명하다고 했다. 외교부는 “정확한 기종 및 물리적 크기 등을 확인하기에는 제약이 있는 상황”이라며 “현장 수거 잔해 등을 추가 분석할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Shortly after the MV NAMUHO incident, U.S. President Donald Trump had stated, "There was gunfire from Iran." In contrast, the South Korean government had taken a cautious stance, saying, "It is still under investigation." (앞서 나무호 사고 직후 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 “이란의 발포가 있었다”고 했었다. 반면 한국 정부는 “아직 조사 중”이라며 신중한 입장을 보였었다.)

At the time, Trump posted on his social media platform Truth Social, saying, "Iran fired several shots at unrelated countries, including a South Korean cargo ship." In an ABC interview, he also said, "Multiple shots were fired targeting a South Korean vessel." However, the following day, a senior presidential official said, "The cause of the explosion is still unknown. It is not clear whether it was a strike or not. We need to investigate first, and it will take quite some time." (당시 트럼프는 소셜미디어 트루스소셜에 “이란이 한국의 화물선을 포함해 (전쟁과) 무관한 국가들을 향해 몇 차례 발포했다”고 했었다. ABC 인터뷰에서도 “한국 선박을 겨냥해 다수 발포가 이뤄졌다”고 했다. 그러나 다음날 청와대 고위 관계자는 “아직 폭발의 원인은 알 수 없다. 피격인지 아닌지도 지금 분명치 않다”며 “일단 조사해 봐야 하는데 시간이 꽤 걸린다”고 했다.)

A government investigation team, consisting of three investigators from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and four forensic experts from the National Fire Agency, has been conducting an investigation into the cause of the fire on the MV NAMUHO at Dubai Port since the 8th. (해양수산부 산하 해양안전심판원 조사관 3명과 소방청 감식 전문가 4명으로 구성된 정부 조사단은 지난 8일부터 두바이항에서 나무호에 대한 화재 원인 조사를 진행해왔다.)

In this regard, Iran's state-run Press TV reported on the 6th (local time), "We targeted a South Korean ship that violated maritime regulations." It further stated, "Targeting a South Korean ship that violated Iran's newly established maritime regulations is a clear signal that Iran will exercise its sovereign rights through kinetic action." (이와 관련 이란 국영 프레스TV는 지난 6일(현지시각) “해상 규정을 위반한 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼았다”고 보도했다. 그러면서 “이란이 새롭게 정한 해상 규정을 위반한 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼은 것은 이란이 무력(kinetic action)을 통해 자국의 주권적 권리를 행사할 것을 분명히 보여주는 신호”라고 했다.)

Earlier, the Iranian Embassy in South Korea had "firmly denied any claims that the Iranian military was involved in the MV NAMUHO explosion," which is a direct contradiction to this latest statement. On the morning of the 4th, when the explosion and fire occurred on the MV NAMUHO, which was anchored off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the UAE, and the previous day, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) was reported to have radioed ships in the area, ordering them to move. (앞서 주한 이란 대사관은 “나무호 폭발에 이란군(軍)이 연루됐다는 어떠한 주장도 단호히 부인한다”고 했었는데, 정반대 주장을 한 것이다. UAE 움알쿠와인 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호에서 폭발·화재가 발생한 지난 4일 오전과 전날 이란 혁명수비대(IRGC)는 이 일대 해상에 있던 선박들에게 이동을 명령하는 무전을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)
